from.place: Membership in an embedded lattice image is local

title: Membership in an embedded lattice image is local
statement: Let X be a scheme, J its pro-etale topology, R and S sheaves of commutative rings on J, a : R → S a ring-sheaf morphism, and L an S-module sheaf. An integral lattice pair on U consists of a finite locally free R|U-module P and a specified isomorphism S|U ⊗ P ≅ L|U, with the sheafified tensor product. Fix U and suppose the coefficient map is injective on every test object of the slice over U. The canonical map from every lattice P to the restriction of L is injective. Its image is preserved by restriction. For T over U, a section z of L(T), and a covering sieve s on T, if each restriction of z along s belongs to the corresponding image of P, then z belongs to the image of P on T. [lem-weil-pbc-lattice-pair-image-classification].

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4(6), pp. 59–60; Descent and an exact presentation of lattice classes

proof.text: Lift the section on each covering arrow. Injectivity proves compatibility. The integral module sheaf glues the lifts, and separatedness of the rational module identifies their image with the original section.

theorem IntegralLatticePair.mem_image_of_locally_mem
    (ha : ∀ T, Function.Injective (((latticeScalarMap a U).hom.app T).hom))
    (P : IntegralLatticePair a L U) (T : Over U) (x : (L.over U).val.obj (op T))
    (s : Sieve T) (hs : s ∈ ((Scheme.ProEt.topology X).over U) T)
    (hx : ∀ (W : Over U) (f : W ⟶ T), s f →
      (L.over U).val.map f.op x ∈ P.image (op W)) :
    x ∈ P.image (op T)
